youtube_description:
How big can you print a DTF logo before it turns blurry? The answer is in the file's own pixels. When you upload a design on Sale91 DTF's order form, it shows 'Sharp up to' a width — the widest that file prints at 250 DPI or better from its own pixels. The number is different for every file (in this video it is 7.5 inch). Try a bigger width and the form stops you: 'Bigger would not print sharp', because stretching the same pixels prints blurry. Want a bigger sharp print? Make a bigger file first — just increasing the width number doesn't add sharpness.
